'''Chapter 119''' is titled "Makeshift".

==Cover Page==
[[Diary of Koby-Meppo]], Conclusion: "Laughing [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]] and the Hard-Working Young Men".

As the pleased [[Vice Admiral]] watches, [[Bogard]] easily beats [[Koby]] and [[Helmeppo]] in a two-on-one training match—showing them how much further they have to go before they can even approach a true [[Marine]].

==Short Summary==
[[Dorry]] goes to resume his fight with [[Brogy]] despite his injuries. [[Galdino|Mr. 3]], [[Marianne|Miss Goldenweek]], and [[Gem|Mr. 5]] set in motion their plan to kill Dorry and lure the Straw Hats into a trap, and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Nami]] are caught by duplicates of their crewmates. [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] correctly deduces that [[Baroque Works]] agents have come after them, and Mr. 3 interferes in Dorry and Brogy's fight, giving Brogy an opportunity to finish Dorry off.

==Long Summary==
[[Usopp]] encourages [[Brogy]] as he heads to fight [[Dorry]] again, and [[Nami]] decides to go back to the ship to meet back up with everyone. Usopp says he is unable to fight off all the dinosaurs on the way back, but promises to one day become a proud warrior of the seas, and Nami decides to instead go and see Luffy at Dorry's campsite. Meanwhile, Dorry puts the entire mountain on top of Luffy, preventing the pirate from stopping him from fighting. He states that he cannot avoid this fight no matter how injured he is, as his god wills it. Luffy is unable to understand being willing to die for a god in an unfair fight, but Dorry says that Luffy does not understand the highest honor of [[Elbaph]]. Dorry and Brogy then confront each other, and [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] is surprised by how invested Luffy is in Dorry's safety despite only having just met the giant.

Meanwhile, [[Galdino|Mr. 3]], [[Marianne|Miss Goldenweek]], and [[Gem|Mr. 5]] conspire against their enemies. With the Straw Hats in chaos due to the exploding rum, the [[Baroque Works]] agents prepare to take out Dorry first, before luring the Straw Hats into a trap. Mr. 3 has pictures of Luffy, [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], Nami, and Vivi. Zoro is lost after hunting a triceratops when he thinks he sees Nami leaning against a nearby tree. However, the figure that looks like Nami does not make a sound, and smirks. The real Nami is running away from a dinosaur with Usopp, and she sees a duplicate of Luffy leaning on a tree. She goes up to it, and screams after seeing what it really is. Usopp hears her screams, and panics due to being unable to see her. He runs out of the woods to Luffy and Vivi, saying that Nami was eaten by the dinosaur. He admits that he did not look to check due to his fear of the dinosaurs, and Vivi wonders if Baroque Works sent someone here after them. She and Luffy suspect that they may have rigged the rum, and Usopp is aghast when he finds out about Dorry's injury. Dorry is currently only at a slight disadvantage as he fights Brogy, but Mr. 3 decides to interfere. He creates a slippery white substance under Dorry's foot that causes him to slip, leaving him open for Brogy to hit him.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Dorry]] traps [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] under the mountain.
*The [[Baroque Works]] agents currently know the identities of Luffy, [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], and [[Nami]] in addition to [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]]. They plot to lure them into a trap.
**Nami and Zoro are captured by [[Galdino|Mr. 3]].
*[[Usopp]] meets up with Vivi and Luffy.
*[[Brogy]] is able to gain the upper hand against Dorry because of Mr. 3's interference.
